review_method: Independent labeled review of exact final atlas, native 192x208 ordered cells, boundary strips, final contact/direction sheets and exported motion stills. No claim of live GIF or MP4 playback.

cardinals.observed: Chin tipped upward and eyes aimed upward; face retained.
Face/nose and eye aim to screen-right; anchored front-facing torso.
Chin tucked and eyelids/eyes downcast; residual leftward head yaw does not obscure downward primary axis.
Nose/face and gaze turn to screen-left; torso and feet retained.

quadrants.observed: Upward gaze/chin with increasing rightward face turn.
Gaze descends while face/rightward eye aim remains; 157.5 nearly frontal but rightward component visible.
Downcast eyes/chin with leftward face turn; adjacent 202.5 and225 very similar.
Lifted eyes/chin with leftward face aim easing back toward front.

registration: All sixteen visible bounds end at y201; boots remain fixed, torso remains front-facing, head/goggles/hair articulate. No clipping, missing face, detached components or conspicuous global scale change observed in ordered native stills.

boundaries.evidence: Largest head-perspective step: near-frontal down-right changes to down with residual left yaw, changing goggles/hair perspective more than neighboring increments. Primary gaze axes remain valid; treated as minor aesthetic continuity variation.
Up-left gaze and chin position ease into frontal upward gaze; torso/boots stable.

limitations: Angular interpolation is stylized and nonuniform;202.5/225 are close in appearance.
Live GIF/MP4 timing and perceived playback smoothness were not directly viewed by this tool.
Native-frame visual review cannot guarantee frontend runtime behavior.
standard_states: Rechecked final contact and exported motion-stills; distinct idle, wave, jump, failure, waiting, thinking/review, directional gait semantics retained. Prior native standard review accepted corrected profile scale and ground return.
